stem: A pharmacist licensed by examination in another state seeks Massachusetts licensure by reciprocity. Which statements are correct? Select all that apply.

choices.text: The applicant must be in good standing in all states where the applicant holds a licence.
A passing MPJE score of at least 75% is required.
Documentation of internship experience in accordance with 247 CMR 8.01 is required.
The applicant may be required to appear personally before the Board.
Reciprocity waives the MPJE because the applicant already passed a jurisprudence examination elsewhere.

explanation.core_reasoning: 247 CMR 3.02 requires good standing in all states where the applicant is licensed and a jurisdiction whose competency requirements are equal to those of Massachusetts. 247 CMR 3.02(2)(a) and (3)(a) require documented internship experience, a passing MPJE score of at least 75%, and personal appearance before the Board if requested. MPJE is not waived on the reciprocity pathway.

choice_analysis.A: Correct: good standing must extend to every state where the applicant holds a licence.
choice_analysis.B: Correct: a passing MPJE score of at least 75% is required.
choice_analysis.C: Correct: internship experience must be documented.
choice_analysis.D: Correct: personal appearance may be required.
choice_analysis.E: MPJE is expressly required on the reciprocity pathway.

related_facts: The Board must recognise the other jurisdiction for reciprocity purposes.
explanation.mpje_trap: Reciprocity transfers a licence, not the Massachusetts jurisprudence requirement.

reasoning_steps: Confirm the applicant was licensed by examination elsewhere
Apply the good-standing requirement across all held licences
Retain the Massachusetts MPJE and internship documentation requirements
